about: Adrian Lores De La Pena, the founder and principal of The Miami Tax Lawyer® in Miami, Florida, is more than just a tax attorney; he's a navigator in the complex seas of tax law. With a blend of sharp analytical skills and innovative strategies, he is dedicated to guiding individuals and businesses toward favorable outcomes. His competence spans IRS compliance, business tax planning and dispute resolution, with a special focus on advising entrepreneurs on entity structuring.

For Mr. Lores De La Pena, the legal field is a thrilling arena where he tackles intricate problems and transforms lives. It's a fusion of analytical thinking, advocacy and creativity, all aimed at fostering trust and empowering his clients. He doesn't just offer legal advice; he empowers clients to make informed decisions that align with their financial and operational aspirations.

Mr. Lores De La Pena’s commitment to public service, ignited during law school with extensive pro bono work, earned him Pro Bono Commendations in 2016 and 2017 for over 800 hours of community service. This dedication infuses his client-centered approach, ensuring that individual needs are not just met but understood.

Driven by a desire to positively impact lives and the community, Mr. Lores De La Pena finds fulfillment in guiding clients through complex legal challenges, offering support and information every step of the way. His commitment extends to pro bono work, educational outreach and advocating for underserved groups, all fueled by a passion for fairness and empowerment.

Mr. Lores De La Pena's excellence has been recognized by Lawyers of Distinction, a testament to his exceptional skill and dedication in the legal field. Fluent in both English and Spanish, he proudly serves a diverse clientele, ensuring everyone feels empowered to make the best decisions. As a sought-after speaker and educator, he champions compliance and awareness of IRS regulations among tax preparers and business owners.
